thesis: Three big events land within 60 hours: core PCE Wednesday at 8:30, NVDA after Wednesday's close, and Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote Friday at 10:00. They arrive with the 10Y at a 52-week-high 4.738%, hawkish 9-3 Fed minutes, WTI at $87 on a physical Hormuz blockade, 50% Section 338 tariffs on Canada now live, and VIX at only 15.13 (Canary Watch on CAUTION, three or more regime flags raised). The one call all three Council members share is the volume-confirmed healthcare breakout, so the core is LLY and JNJ, with XOM as the hedge against oil pushing inflation and yields higher. That agreement is itself concentration risk (Scar 4), and leaving NVDA out would be a bet against the quarter's biggest print, so MSFT plus NVDA at roughly its SPY weight keep the book from badly trailing a tech rebound. 20% cash matches the Council's 15-20% posture going into these events without sitting out a rising market.
risks: A strong NVDA outlook plus a patient Warsh could set off a rally in chips, growth and rate-sensitive stocks, likely funded by selling healthcare, which this defensive, 20%-cash book would trail; a Hormuz de-escalation headline would hit XOM while lifting SPY. I have no memory of how this week actually traded and used none; the book rests only on the folder's Aug 21-22 information.
